recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Further edits for FHIR-8024 would be redundant with the active conformance rules, CapabilityStatement.document, and the already-audited FHIR-38932 wording update.
issue_request: FHIR-8024 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification DSTU1 clarification asking what "framework" meant in the FHIR Documents sentence "Applications claiming conformance to this framework claim to be conformant to 'FHIR documents'." The approved resolution said there were three conformance claims, tied to Conformance resource sections, and requested clarification on the conformance page and the conformance statement resource page.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN revision 6214, now git commit 4956a5f9552c691c825e488cde668506039c8513, which rewrote the conformance rules page to introduce the RESTful FHIR, FHIR messaging, and FHIR documents exchange frameworks and added a documents-page link to that conformance explanation.
additional_context: Current FHIR has renamed Conformance to CapabilityStatement, and the active CapabilityStatement resource contains the document section used to declare document support. A later Published ballot issue, FHIR-38932, replaced the same documents-page sentence with explicit CapabilityStatement.document wording. That related issue is already represented on the combined branch, so this result does not duplicate it.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current documents page directly says that applications declaring support for FHIR documents with CapabilityStatement.document assert conformance to the rules on the page; the conformance rules page lists the three exchange frameworks; and the CapabilityStatement source includes the document section for document support declarations.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue replaced the same documents-page sentence with explicit CapabilityStatement.document wording; it is already represented on the combined branch by ca84a5fdceb50c6e078093eb8438cb8d1892e381.
